--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -6.0000f);
  glRotatef(10.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(15.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  glFrontFace(GL_CW);
  glRotatef(10*t, 0, 0, 1);
  // Same concave arrow as the previous example, plus a second contour: a
  // smaller arrow traced inside the first. The tessellator's default odd
  // winding rule fills a point only when it sits inside an odd number of
  // contours, so the inner contour punches a hole.
  gluBegin(GLU_POLYGON);
    gluBegin(GLU_CONTOUR);
      gluNormal(0, 0, 1);
      gluColor(0.36, 0.7, 0.98, 1);
      gluVertex(-1.2, -0.45, 0);
      gluColor(0.36, 0.7, 0.98, 1);
      gluVertex(-1.2, 0.45, 0);
      gluColor(0.62, 0.52, 0.95, 1);
      gluVertex(0, 0.45, 0);
      gluColor(0.98, 0.46, 0.36, 1);
      gluVertex(0, 1.1, 0);
      gluColor(0.98, 0.76, 0.36, 1);
      gluVertex(1.3, 0, 0);
      gluColor(0.98, 0.46, 0.36, 1);
      gluVertex(0, -1.1, 0);
      gluColor(0.62, 0.52, 0.95, 1);
      gluVertex(0, -0.45, 0);
    gluEnd();
    // Inner contour = the cutout. Grey so the hole edge reads against the
    // colored face.
    gluBegin(GLU_CONTOUR);
      gluColor(0.45, 0.49, 0.58, 1);
      gluVertex(-0.6, -0.225, 0);
      gluVertex(-0.6, 0.225, 0);
      gluVertex(0.2, 0.225, 0);
      gluVertex(0.2, 0.55, 0);
      gluVertex(0.85, 0, 0);
      gluVertex(0.2, -0.55, 0);
      gluVertex(0.2, -0.225, 0);
    gluEnd();
  gluEnd();
